name: realtor-market-system
description: The Monthly Market System — the Market Update AI Agent. It schedules itself the moment the agent installs it, times itself to when their local real estate board actually publishes (and re-times itself as it learns), then every month pulls the fresh local numbers and builds the entire package off them: the branded PRESENTATION they screen-record (talking points under every slide — no script needed), the sendable PDF market report that doubles as a green-screen asset and the lead magnet, three short-form concepts, the Instagram 1:1 infographic AND carousel, and the distribution pack with a two-CTA newsletter. It grades last month's on-camera prediction against the numbers that just landed — the ledger segment almost no agent runs — then writes the whole month onto the same Notion Content Dashboard the YouTube and Short-Form systems use, so an unattended run is actually visible. Between runs it's a market advisor in chat — ask how any community, price range, or property type is doing, what changed since last month, what a home costs per month at today's rates, or what to tell a seller who asks if now's the time, answered instantly from the numbers already on file. Every asset ships as a paste-ready Claude Design brief with the real numbers already in it. The realtor's only job is to film. Numbers are researched once into the Brain and quoted everywhere, so nothing ever disagrees; sourced and dated or it doesn't ship, with a stated fallback for markets whose board publishes nothing. Text, data, and design briefs only — it never designs, films, or publishes. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first.
